h1: Backlink building for AI and organic search
productDescription: Snoika places backlinks that support content a brand has already published, rather than writing new content to hang links on. The work runs weekly: identify high-authority resources relevant to the published article, create the supporting post and the visuals that make the placement organic, then publish through an automated workflow so distribution keeps running without anyone chasing it. Placements target domains with Domain Authority 85 and above. Snoika frames the approach as publish first, distribute smarter. Source: snoika.com/solutions/backlinks-strategy. No standalone price for this service is published, so do not state one.
clientProof: Source: results published by Snoika at snoika.com/customers. 3DPrinterOS, 3D printing SaaS: 3 to 4 qualified inbound leads per day, and first position in ChatGPT for industry-specific queries. Vespia, fintech SaaS: 220% increase in AI brand mentions. 1StopVAT, tax and fintech: 10x growth in ChatGPT visibility, achieved in 7 weeks. 3DOS, 3D printing network: 2x growth in registered users. ABS Technologies, IT services: 6x SERP impressions within the first 30 days. Agrello, e-signature: 125.6% increase in organic search sessions year on year, and 51,800 impressions from Snoika-created pages. Snoika does not publish a backlink count, a Domain Authority gain or a referring-domain figure for any of these, so do not attribute the results above to backlinks alone and do not state a link-specific number.
certifications: Member of the NVIDIA Inception Program. Source: snoika.com. This is a startup programme membership rather than an audited certification, so describe it as a membership and never present it as ISO, SOC 2 or an audit. Snoika publishes no security or compliance certification, so never claim one.
writingPreferences: Address the reader as "you" and assume they already publish content and are wondering why it is not ranking. Never call Snoika a "platform" or a "solution" — it is an agency. Do not use the phrase "link juice". Do not name any specific publisher, blog or domain as a placement target. Reproduce every figure exactly as supplied and never round it.
